events.description: Two independent event hierarchies — standard EventBus events (IEvent/IAsyncEvent) and ECS events (EcsEvent). They share no base class and use completely different dispatch mechanisms.

standardEvents.description: Traditional observer-pattern event bus. Events are dispatched through EventBus, registered via IEventRegistry. Supports keyed dispatch, priority ordering, sync/async, global/unhandled listeners.

IBaseEvent.description: Root marker interface for all standard events. KeyType parameterizes keyed dispatch — Void for non-keyed events.

IEvent.description: Synchronous event marker. Dispatched synchronously on the calling thread.

IAsyncEvent.description: Asynchronous event marker. Dispatched via CompletableFuture chains.

ICancellable.description: Standalone cancellation interface for standard events. NOT related to ICancellableEcsEvent.

IProcessedEvent.description: Callback interface invoked after each consumer processes the event. Used for auditing/tracing which listeners handled an event.

prioritySystem.description: Priority values are shorts. Consumers at a given priority execute in registration order. Lower numeric value = earlier execution. Custom short values are also supported.

Registration.description: Base registration handle. Tracks enabled state and provides unregister callback.

EventRegistration.description: Handle returned when registering an event listener. The combine() static method chains multiple registrations so they enable/unregister together.

dispatchMethods: EventType dispatch(Class<EventType> eventClass) — dispatch non-keyed sync event
CompletableFuture<EventType> dispatchAsync(Class<EventType> eventClass) — dispatch non-keyed async event
IEventDispatcher<EventType, EventType> dispatchFor(Class, KeyType) — get keyed sync dispatcher
IEventDispatcher<EventType, CompletableFuture<EventType>> dispatchForAsync(Class, KeyType) — get keyed async dispatcher
IEventBus.description: Central event bus interface. dispatch() is a convenience for dispatchFor(class, null).dispatch(null). The dispatchFor/dispatchForAsync pattern returns a reusable dispatcher object.

IEventDispatcher.description: Functional dispatcher interface. Both SyncEventConsumerMap and AsyncEventConsumerMap implement this, allowing the map itself to be the dispatcher.

EventBus.keyBehavior: Lazily creates SyncEventBusRegistry or AsyncEventBusRegistry per event class on first register/dispatch. Routes IAsyncEvent subclasses to async registry, everything else to sync.

dispatchFlow.sync: dispatchFor(class, key) -> SyncEventBusRegistry.dispatchFor(key) -> SyncEventConsumerMap.dispatch(event) -> iterate priority-sorted consumers -> call global -> call unhandled if no keyed listeners handled it
dispatchFlow.async: dispatchForAsync(class, key) -> AsyncEventBusRegistry.dispatchFor(key) -> AsyncEventConsumerMap.dispatch(event) -> CompletableFuture chain through priority-sorted functions -> global -> unhandled

EventBusRegistry.description: Abstract per-event-class registry inside EventBus. Manages keyed consumer maps, a global map, and an unhandled map.

innerClasses.EventConsumer: Base consumer wrapper: index (global counter), priority (short), consumerString (toString of lambda), Metric timer
innerClasses.EventConsumerMap: Priority-sorted consumer list using Short2ObjectConcurrentHashMap. Maintains sorted short[] priorities array via atomic CAS. Implements IEventDispatcher.

SyncEventBusRegistry.dispatchSemantics: Iterates priority-sorted consumers, calls Consumer.accept(event). Returns boolean 'handled'. If keyed map handles, skips unhandled listeners. Global always fires.
SyncEventBusRegistry.NO_OP: Static no-op dispatcher that returns the event unchanged.

AsyncEventBusRegistry.dispatchSemantics: Chains CompletableFuture through Function<CF<E>, CF<E>> at each priority level. Uses thenComposeAsync for initial dispatch. Global and unhandled fire as future chain stages.

listenerCategories.keyed: register(class, key, consumer) — only fires when dispatched with matching key
listenerCategories.global: registerGlobal(class, consumer) — fires for ALL dispatches of that event class regardless of key
listenerCategories.unhandled: registerUnhandled(class, consumer) — fires only when NO keyed listener handled the event
listenerCategories.async: registerAsync variants use Function<CF<E>, CF<E>> instead of Consumer<E>

pluginScopedRegistry.description: Plugin-scoped wrapper around IEventRegistry. Delegates all registrations to parent (the actual EventBus), wraps them in plugin lifecycle tracking. All registrations auto-unregister on plugin shutdown.

Ref.description: Lightweight entity reference. Index into the Store's entity arrays. Invalidated (index = Integer.MIN_VALUE) when entity is removed. Tracks invalidation source for debugging.

Dependency.description: Base class for system ordering constraints.

types.RootDependency: Relative to root of execution order. first() = CLOSEST priority, last() = FURTHEST. Cannot use BEFORE.
types.SystemDependency: Relative to a specific system class. BEFORE/AFTER with priority.
types.SystemTypeDependency: Relative to all systems of a given SystemType.
types.SystemGroupDependency: Relative to all systems in a given SystemGroup.

DependencyGraph.description: Topological sort with priority-weighted edges. Edges connect beforeSystem -> afterSystem. Root edges have null beforeSystem (always fulfilled). Sort iterates: find fulfilled edges with no unfulfilled dependencies, resolve, fulfill downstream. Detects cycles.

ParallelRangeTask.description: Splits a range [from, to) across TASK_COUNT sub-tasks. Each sub-task has its own IntConsumer (SystemTaskData). After completion, CommandBuffers are merged back.

setupFlow: 1. PluginBase constructor creates all registries with shutdownTasks list and precondition = (state != NONE && state != DISABLED)
3. setup0() → setup() — SETUP state, plugin registers components/systems/events
5. shutdown0() → shutdown() → cleanup() — SHUTDOWN → DISABLED/FAILED state
cleanupOrder: 10. shutdownTasks iterated in REVERSE order — calls BooleanConsumer.accept(isShutdown)
lifecycleFlow.unregisterBehavior: When shutdown=false (plugin disable), registrations are actively unregistered from their targets. When shutdown=true (server shutdown), many skip unregistration since everything is being torn down.

crossReferences.eventBusToEcs: Standard events (IEvent/IAsyncEvent) and ECS events (EcsEvent) are completely independent systems. They share the ICancellable/ICancellableEcsEvent pattern but the interfaces are distinct.
crossReferences.pluginToStore: Plugins access ECS via ComponentRegistryProxy<EntityStore> and ComponentRegistryProxy<ChunkStore>, which wrap the static REGISTRY instances.
crossReferences.entityStoreVsChunkStore: EntityStore is for game entities (players, mobs, items). ChunkStore is for chunk-level systems (block data, terrain). Both are Store<T> with different type parameters.
crossReferences.deprecationPattern: Several EventBus events are deprecated in favor of ECS equivalents: PlayerInteractEvent → UseBlockEvent, PlayerCraftEvent → CraftRecipeEvent, LivingEntityUseBlockEvent → UseBlockEvent.
crossReferences.asyncEventRarity: PlayerChatEvent is the ONLY IAsyncEvent in the codebase. All other standard events are synchronous IEvent.
